correctness.rationale: The independent root-copy Poisson thinning is exact, and on each rooted path the frozen-center voter dynamics has one domain wall with explicit birth–death rates. The probability of interface absorption before returning to its zero-prefix state from position one is 2/(2r-1), making its total zero-prefix occupation time exponentially distributed at rate 1/(2r-1). Averaging independent root-copy hazards proves the all-parameter product. The degree-weighted martingale gives fixation k/(2L). Strict concavity gives both sharp arm-balance extremes. The r=1 and k=1 boundaries were checked analytically. Full-state killed CTMC agrees for 16 profiles, an independent rational interface solver for 108 cases and all-composition extremes for 40 parameter pairs; these are corroborating finite tests, not proof substitutes.

originality.rationale: The exact center no-flip law on nontrivial path spiders and the sharp fixed-order/degree arm-balance extremal were not found in relevant inspected voter model sources or accessible own-ledger claims. General fixation results, lattice persistence statistics, and clique-bouquet products do not entail this path-interface claim without new analysis. Historical priority remains qualified by explicit residual risks.
residual_risks: A related exact formula could be present in an unindexed thesis, appendix, or older interacting-particle literature; search and inspected sources are not exhaustive historical certification.
The closest local clique-bouquet result shares a star special case and the general branch factorization idea, but does not cover rooted paths of positive length two or greater.
Only selected sections of the 29-page persistence paper and 11-page spectral paper were examined in depth; no whole-document noncoverage claim is made.

value.rationale: The same graph order, center degree, and eventual-win probability can coexist with exactly ordered, substantially different hub persistence values according to how the pendant lengths are allocated. The exact probability is natural in persistence theory, the sharp balancing and concentrating extremals are structurally interpretable, and the contrasting L=2k limits e^-3 and e^-1/3 exhibit a nonvanishing effect not implied by voter fixation.
